newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Malaria kills 22 in Zimbabwe, thousands infected.
newsitem.headline: Malaria kills 22 in Zimbabwe, thousands infected.

text.p: An outbreak of malaria has killed 22 people and infected more than 13,000 others in Zimbabwe since the beginning of the year, the state-owned Herald newspaper reported on Saturday.
It said heavy rains and flooded rivers caused the malaria outbreak in the Mashonaland Central province.
"Official figures show that some 13,549 cases have been reported so far, 6,400 more than the number recorded this time last year," the Herald quoted health authorities as saying.
More than 3,880 cases were reported in the province last week alone, compared to 2,000 cases in the same period last year.
The Herald said that additional health workers, assisted by army medics, had been deployed in the affected areas.
Mosquitoes, carriers of malaria, breed in stagnant water. Zimbabwe has suffered six weeks of incessant rains and more rain is forecast for this month.
